--- grant_execute_on_all_table_functions_in_named_schema.sql
GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL TABLE FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA inventory TO ROLE consumer

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnAllFunctionsInSchema{
    Execute: 6,
    Table:   21,
    Default: -1,
    Schemas: []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 47,
            NameEnd: 56,
            Name:    "inventory",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 65,
      NameEnd: 73,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL TABLE FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA inventory TO ROLE consumer
